parsed.notes:
The optional section begins with “The following isn’t required, but we’d love to see it:”.
The optional advanced degree has no explicit level; applying the guide’s unspecified-degree rule literally leaves bachelor as the highest explicitly named level. Flagged for review because “advanced” could imply a higher level.
REST is covered by the APIs criterion, whose required mention wins over the optional REST mention.
Debugging is unmapped rather than silently equated with software testing; testing is not requested.
The library alternatives form group 1; the examples satisfying the single systems-language ask form group 2. The heterogeneous architecture and deployment examples are not treated as interchangeable alternatives.
Cloud has an independent mention in “major cloud architectures”, so the containerized-or-cloud wording does not produce a surviving two-member alternative group.
Unstructured data types are retained as one unmapped technical familiarity ask; individual modalities are not inferred to require computer vision, NLP, or speech recognition.
Security clearance, citizenship, domain experience, leadership, and general project-delivery abilities are not taxonomy skills.
